title: discover(): unicast subnet scan + directed broadcast fallback
description: P0. When broadcast probe yields no replies, send Discover unicast to each host of local subnets (cap ~1024 targets). Subnet sources: getifaddrs where available, else outbound IP via UDP connect()+getsockname() with /24 assumed, plus directed broadcast (x.y.z.255) best-effort. Always probe localhost.
close_reason: unicast subnet scan + directed broadcast phase-2 fallback

title: [network] scan config: extra CIDRs/peers to probe
description: P0. Add network.scan = [] config: entries 'a.b.c.d/n' (scan subnet) or 'a.b.c.d[:port]' (single host). Escape hatch for platforms without interface enumeration and for off-subnet peers.

title: discover(): poll-based recv, non-fatal setsockopt
description: P0. src/ipc/discovery.rs discover() used set_read_timeout (SO_RCVTIMEO) which returns EINVAL on some platforms. Replaced with poll() on the socket fd + recv_from loop; set_broadcast() is best-effort. Fixes 'UDP discovery failed (Invalid argument)'.

title: LAN discovery & mesh (docs/MESH.md)
description: Implement the SessionManager/directory + mesh design from docs/MESH.md: peer discovery without broadcast, peer cache with TTL, TCP registration, ListPeers, and authenticated relay. Motivation: platforms lacking broadcast/multicast/getifaddrs/SO_RCVTIMEO, plus AP-isolated networks.

title: Investigate SIGSYS on limited/emulated platforms
description: 'invalid system call ./lrmux' seen after server start on emulated Linux — a child hits an unimplemented syscall (SIGSYS). Server still works after. Identify which syscall (candidates: statx, sched_getaffinity, eventfd, memfd, rseq). Options: strace build, or bisect by cfg.

title: Selector/ls: remote sessions via manager peer cache
description: P1. inventory.rs: query configured managers via ListPeers, show their cached sessions as Lan entries; attach direct or via relay (P2).

title: lrmux manager subcommand (standalone directory)
description: P1. New CLI command: directory+broker process with no sessions (HASS add-on use case: 24/7 rendezvous). Shares peers module with servers.

title: ListPeers/PeerList protocol + [peers] directory mode
description: P1. Authed client msg ListPeers -> PeerList{peers}. Served by manager (standalone) or server with [peers] directory=true. Poll is a normal client session: Identify->ListSessions->ListPeers->disconnect.

title: Register/RegisterAck + managers config + verify-by-callback
description: P1. Client->server msg Register{server_id,name,tcp_addr,tls,fingerprint} authed by PSK; [peers] managers=[] makes a node register on startup; [peers] accept_registrations=true on manager. Manager verifies by polling announced tcp_addr; only then state=verified. Anti-spoofing.

title: Peer cache: states, TTL, jittered refresh, peers.json
description: P1. src/server/peers.rs (or src/peers/): entries {server_id,name,addrs,tcp_port,tls,fingerprint,state,psk_ok,sessions,source,last_seen,expires_at}. States announced|verified|stale. Refresh poll at random [0.5,0.9]*ttl. Persist ~/.config/lrmux/peers.json with absolute epochs; drop expired on load, re-poll stale.

title: Announce v2 wire format + active announce
description: P1. Extend UDP Announce: ver=2, +server_id(16B), +flags(leaving bit for graceful shutdown). Active announces: on startup, on session change, ~60s heartbeat, to broadcast (best-effort) + directed + unicast to known peers/managers. [network] announce = true knob.
close_reason: Announce v2 (server_id + leaving flag), parser accepts v1+v2, active announces on startup/60s heartbeat/shutdown via [network] announce knob

title: server_id UUID persistence (~/.config/lrmux/server.id)
description: P1. Generate UUID v4 once, persist, reuse. Peers keyed by server_id since tcp ports auto-assign and change. Needed by Announce v2 + peer cache dedup.
close_reason: config::server_id() persists a UUID v4 at config_dir()/server.id; fallback entropy via sha2(time,pid) if urandom unavailable

title: Replace remaining set_read_timeout with poll
description: P0-bugfix. SO_RCVTIMEO fails EINVAL on some platforms. set_read_timeout call sites (client/control.rs, client/inventory.rs query_sessions_*) were 'let _ =' so they silently lost the timeout — a hung peer would block reads forever. Replaced with poll()-based deadlines.

title: Single discovery responder per host without port sharing
description: On platforms without SO_REUSEPORT / where SO_REUSEADDR doesn't share UDP ports, only one lrmux server per host can bind the discovery port. bind_server() warns already; document in docs/ and prefer directory registration over the shared UDP port on such platforms.
close_reason: Documented in docs/MESH.md 1.1 capability table: one discovery responder per host where SO_REUSEPORT is missing; registration to a manager is the fallback.

title: Client attach via relay: --via <manager>, E2E TLS through pipe
description: P2. Client opens RelayOpen to manager for target addr, then runs normal Identify+TLS+PSK through the pipe (relay sees ciphertext). Auto-fallback when direct connect fails; attach --via flag.

title: RelayOpen byte-pipe relay (auth-gated)
description: P2. RelayOpen{addr} on authed conn -> server TCP-connects addr -> RelayReady -> pipe raw bytes both ways. Requires auth (else open LAN proxy/SSRF). [peers] relay=true enables.
